data.name: Buddy
data.gender_notes: Buddy is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name for a friend or companion. Derived from the Old English word ‘budga’, meaning ‘companion’. The name Buddy carries the meaning “Friend” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English. Parents who choose Buddy usually hope their child will grow to embody friend and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name given to signify a deep spiritual bond or friendship with another being, whether human or divine.
data.etymology: Buddy belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Friend.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Buddy total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_hebrew.name: באדי
in_hebrew.long_meaning: באדי הוא שם שפירושו חבר או אח, והוא נגזר מהמילה העברית 'חבר'. השם באדי משקף את הרעיון של קשר חברתי חזק ואחווה, והוא נמצא בשימוש במסגרת השמות הנוצריים כדי לבטא את הקשר בין אלוהים לאדם, כמו גם את הקשר בין בני אדם.

in_greek.name: Μπάντι
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Μπάντι προέρχεται από την ελληνική λέξη για σύντροφο ή αδελφός. Στην Καινή Διαθήκη, η έννοια της αδελφοσύνης και της συντροφιάς είναι κεντρική στο μήνυμα του Χριστού για την αγάπη και την ενότητα μεταξύ των πιστών. Το όνομα Μπάντι αντανακλά αυτήν την έννοια της πνευματικής συντροφιάς και της αδελφοσύνης.

in_latin.name: Buddy
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Buddy originem habet in termino 'amice' vel 'frater', quod relationem amicitiae vel fraternitatis significat. In ecclesia primitiva, haec conceptio fraternitatis et amicitiae spiritualis erat centralis in Christi doctrina de amore et unitate inter fideles. Nomen Buddy hanc notionem spiritualem amicitiae et fraternitatis reflectit.

in_english.name: Buddy
in_english.long_meaning: The name Buddy is derived from the term 'buddy', which means a close friend or companion. While not directly mentioned in the Bible, the concept of friendship and companionship is highly valued in Christian tradition. Buddy reflects the idea of a close, supportive relationship, often seen as a gift from God. Historically, the name gained popularity in the 20th century as a given name, symbolizing friendship and camaraderie.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Buddy" has been popular among Christians as well as the general population, gaining the most popularity in the United States during the 20th century. It has been given as a nickname or formal name to signify a close friend or loyal companion. This usage of the name reflects the value Christians place on community, support, and deep connections.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name "Buddy" lies in the biblical concept of friendship with God. In Scripture, we see numerous examples of God's friendship with His people (Isaiah 41:8, Psalm 25:14, Proverbs 18:24, John 15:13-15). By adopting the name "Buddy," Christians may be reminded of their deep spiritual connection with God. Moreover, Christians can see their friends and loved ones as reflections of God's love and companionship in their lives.
